subject.title: feat(mobile): default pairing to full node access

question: Should official mobile setup grant effective full Gateway administrative and pairing authority by default once the canonical-client restriction and native behavior are proven?
rationale: Moving the ordinary mobile onboarding credential from bounded operator access to effective administrative authority is a permanent product and security-boundary choice that tests cannot authorize.

options.title: Approve after hardening
options.body: Adopt full-by-default only after the P1 authorization path is closed, documentation is corrected, conflicts are resolved, and native proof is supplied.

options.title: Keep limited by default
options.body: Preserve bounded access as the default and require operators to select full access explicitly.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Defer the feature until maintainers establish a different mobile authorization and upgrade model.

recommendation.title: Approve after hardening
recommendation.body: Adopt full-by-default only after the P1 authorization path is closed, documentation is corrected, conflicts are resolved, and native proof is supplied.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied evidence identifies steipete as the feature proposer and author of the complete implementation series, though broader ownership history remains unavailable.
